name: Blue Check
storyline:
A young woman has recently moved into a new apartment, hoping to leave the past behind and start a new chapter of her life. Alone within the walls of her new home, her computer becomes her only connection to the outside world. Through messages and online conversations, she keeps in touch with her friends, trying to maintain a sense of normality despite the growing isolation surrounding her.

But as days go by, the boundaries between her quiet daily routine and the memories she has tried so hard to bury begin to blur. Old traumas slowly resurface, haunting her thoughts and affecting the way she perceives the world around her. What initially seems like an ordinary attempt to rebuild her life gradually turns into a disturbing journey through her own mind.
summary:
Blue Check is an experimental psychological horror.

Experience the life of a young woman who has just moved into a new apartment. Explore her everyday life through her computer. Play minigames, read the latest news, shop for new items to decorate your home, and, most importantly, chat with your friends!

Powered by AI-driven text generation, NPCs respond dynamically to your messages, making every conversation feel like a real chat. Enjoy the freedom of talking to characters who react to what you say... while it lasts...

But there's more to the girl's life than meets the eye. A dark secret lies beneath the surface, waiting to be uncovered.

Will you discover the truth?
